pages.text: This library lets programs touch the world around the trigger block:

$(li)TICKS: the game time$(li)BEEP, SOUND: play notes like a note block$(li)SAY: write a message to the chat$(li)GET_BLOCK: read a block and its redstone power$(li)GET_INVENTORY: read the items in a chest or other container

$(li)GET_LEVER, SET_LEVER: read or flip levers$(li)GET_BUTTON, PRESS_BUTTON: read or press buttons$(li)GET_PRESSURE_PLATE: read pressure plates$(li)GET_OPEN, SET_OPEN: doors, trapdoors and fence gates$(li)FIND_ENTITIES: find mobs and items nearby
